==Biography==
Glazkov was born in Donetsk. He first played ''World of Warcraft'' and then later switched over to ''Dota''.

== Trivia ==
* Initially a top laner, PvPStejos rejoined [[Hard Random]] in September 2015 as a jungler. He then switched back to top lane upon joining [[Gambit Esports]] in June 2017 until December 2019. After taking [[LCL/2020 Season/Spring Season|2020 Spring]] off and becoming a head coach ahead of [[LCL/2020 Season/Summer Season|the following split]], he finally marks his return in the jungle for [[Gambit Esports]] in January 2021.
* Is notable for not using any alternate skins for any of the champions he plays.
